note: Plupload file widget provides two field widgets built on the plupload module: 'plupload_file_widget' for core file fields (no settings) and 'plupload_image_widget' for core image fields (one setting preview_image_style, schema field.widget.settings.plupload_image_widget). It renders a #type=>plupload element with #autoupload+#autosubmit, chunked uploads with chunk_size/max_file_size derived from PHP upload_max_filesize/post_max_size, runtimes html5,flash,silverlight,html4. No field type, settings form, permission, drush, or config route. Depends on drupal/plupload. Medium cases install known state (a file field using the widget; an image widget's preview_image_style). Hard cases build real state verified against the live entity_form_display: set a file field's widget to plupload_file_widget, and set an image field's widget to plupload_image_widget with a preview style. Fixtures namespaced field_plw_*.

evals.prompt: Using the plupload_widget (Plupload file widget) module on Drupal 11, which field widget do I select on Manage form display for a core File field, and which one for a core Image field?
evals.expected_output: Use the 'plupload_file_widget' widget for a core File field and the 'plupload_image_widget' widget for a core Image field, selected on the field's Manage form display.

evals.prompt: What does the plupload_widget module's widget do differently from the standard file upload widget, and what does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It renders a Plupload (#type => plupload) element with #autoupload and #autosubmit so files upload on selection and the form auto-submits; uploads are chunked (chunk_size/max_file_size computed from PHP upload_max_filesize/post_max_size), enabling large-file uploads with progress. It depends on the drupal/plupload module.

evals.prompt: The plupload_widget image widget has a configurable setting. What is it and what does it control?
evals.expected_output: The plupload_image_widget has a single setting, preview_image_style (config schema field.widget.settings.plupload_image_widget), which sets the image style used for the uploaded-image preview. The plupload_file_widget has no settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, one File field on the Article content type uses the Plupload upload widget on its default form display. Inspect the live configuration and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: field_plw_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component uses widget type 'plupload_file_widget'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an Image field (field_plw_img) using the Plupload image widget with a configured preview image style. Inspect the live form-display configuration and give the image style machine name it uses for the preview.
evals.expected_output: The field_plw_img component's plupload_image_widget has settings.preview_image_style = 'large' (readable via `drush cget core.entity_form_display.node.article.default content.field_plw_img`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a File field field_plw_task whose form display uses the standard core file widget. Using the plupload_widget module, switch that field's widget to the Plupload file widget so it supports chunked uploads. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_plw_task component's widget type is 'plupload_file_widget' (set via Manage form display or the entity_form_display config).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an Image field field_plw_disp using the standard core image widget. Using the plupload_widget module, change its form-display widget to the Plupload image widget and set the preview image style to 'thumbnail'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_plw_disp component has widget type 'plupload_image_widget' and settings.preview_image_style 'thumbnail'.
